result.title: Evolve in Panorama, Render in View: Panoramic World State Evolution for Video World Models
result.summary: Video world models should maintain a world that keeps evolving as the viewpoint changes. Yet when the camera turns away and returns, current models often freeze the unobserved scene, lose objects, or change their appearance, because content outside the view has no representation that keeps changing. We present PanoEvo, which uses a Panoramic Evolver to evolve the world state in the latent space of a panoramic video diffusion model, where every viewing direction is present at every time step, so the scene evolves whether or not it is observed. Existing panoramic video models are not trained to evolve a scene from a single image or the objects within it, so we build PanoEvo-Data, an event-centric dataset from real 360° videos, and train the Panoramic Evolver coarse-to-fine as an image-to-panoramic-video model. Since each view covers only a small part of the low-resolution panorama, directly projected views are blurry and often show low-quality details or structural errors. A Perspective Renderer, built on a perspective video diffusion model, reads this state via latent-space projection and direction-restricted cross-attention to render sharp, high-quality views. PanoEvo achieves the best overall score among 23 publicly evaluated models on WRBench and the highest total score on STEVO-Bench. Code, models, and data will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PanoEvo，在全景视频扩散模型的 latent 空间中持续演化世界状态，并用透视渲染器经 latent 投影与方向受限 cross-attention 生成清晰视角，同时构建事件级 360° 数据用于训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「未被观察方向仍在 latent 中持续更新、再按视角定向读取」的机制，可能为 LVR 中视域外视觉证据的保留、筛选与读取（含注意力结构对 latent 读取的影响）提供借鉴线索，但属视频世界模型，与推理任务的关联待核查。
